portalsFound.observation: Official Shenzhen cadastral-map viewer says any person may query parcel boundaries, codes, area, and land use free of charge. Stated scope is Shenzhen city except the Shenshan Cooperation Zone; map data updates in real time. This is a viewing service, with no reusable feature-list endpoint verified.
Official registration center links the cadastral-map query and property-information query as separate services.
